description.value: The Sunflower Café is a beloved Crescent Beach institution serving wholesome breakfast and lunch for over 20 years, with everything made in-house from whole ingredients including freshly baked multigrain sourdough. Its garden patio welcomes guests and their pets on sunny days, while the interior features rotating local artwork and comfortable seating. A stocked freezer of take-home soups and prepared meals offers a practical resupply option for cyclists passing through the White Rock and Crescent Beach area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM phone (604-541-8511), address (12310 Beecher Street, Surrey, BC V4A 3A6), and URL; the business describes itself as a 'beloved Crescent Beach Café and local institution for over 20 years' with a garden patio, indoor seating with local artwork, and extensive breakfast/lunch menu. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options are explicitly labelled throughout the menu and catering pages; takeout is confirmed via 'Take us home with you!' messaging and a stocked fridge of frozen meals. No website evidence was found for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycle-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM name field uses 'The Sunflower Cafe' (no accent); website consistently uses 'The Sunflower Café' with accent on the final 'e'.
OSM data is sourced from City of Surrey 2010 GIS data with a surrey:date of 1985-10-22; business is confirmed active via a current website with 2025 copyright.
Postal code V4A 3A6 confirmed via website contact page but is absent from OSM address tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established 20+ year café in Crescent Beach, a popular cycling destination along the White Rock waterfront trail, offering a full breakfast and lunch menu with confirmed GF/vegan options and takeout — a practical and welcoming stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu offers gluten-free bread substitutes and daily GF specials; catering/frozen menu explicitly labels multiple soups as 'GF & Vegan' (Thai Vegetable, Moroccan Pea, Southwest Black Bean, Yam and Peanut) and 'Vegetarian & GF'; hummus and cream cheese sandwich options are vegetarian

wow_evidence: beloved Crescent Beach Café and local institution for over 20 years
